slides.title: Hadoop changes the strategy: move compute to distributed data

slides.title: Big Data Analytics converts large-scale data into action

slides.title: Analytics asks four levels of questions
slides.subtitle: Each level increases decision support: what happened, why, what may happen and what should be done.

slides.title: Descriptive and diagnostic analytics explain the past
slides.subtitle: They are often the first step before prediction or prescription.

slides.title: Predictive and prescriptive analytics guide future action

slides.title: Analytics appears wherever decisions repeat
slides.subtitle: The same analytical structure works in education, banking, healthcare, transport, retail and media platforms.
